summary.text: Blake Cummings is the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma House of Representatives District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican incumbent Danny Williams.
A management consultant and native Oklahoman, he says he is running to improve education outcomes and protect Medicaid expansion.

paragraphs.text: Cummings graduated from Kinta High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Oklahoma in 1982 and completed a graduate degree at Southeastern Oklahoma State University in 2021.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as management consultant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in Muskogee and raised in Haskell County, is the son of a school teacher father and a Choctaw mother, and lives with his wife in Pottawatomie County.
Cummings's Democratic primary was canceled, and he advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.

In the survey, he said improving education outcomes is the most pro-business goal a state government can have, called for keeping Medicaid expansion, and urged closer work with Oklahoma's tribal nations.
